Command.Comment: RAGIN EDGE live negative mTLS probes (no secrets)

commands:
set -euo pipefail
echo RUN
date -u
CERT_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.crt
KEY_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/edge.key
CA_FILE=/etc/ragin/tls/ca.crt
CERTS_READY=0
if [ -n "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -n "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -n "$CA_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CERT_FILE" ] && [ -f "$KEY_FILE" ] && [ -f "$CA_FILE" ]; then
  CERTS_READY=1
fi
echo CERTS_READY=$CERTS_READY
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
echo TMPDIR=$TMPDIR
if [ "$CERTS_READY" = "1" ] && command -v openssl >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "CASE_1_MISSING_CERT"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "$CA_FILE" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/case1_missing_cert.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE1_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE1_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo CASE1_HEAD_BEGIN
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/case1_missing_cert.txt"
  echo CASE1_HEAD_END
  echo "CASE_2_BAD_CA_CHAIN"
  if openssl s_client -connect 172.31.17.217:8443 \
    -CAfile "${TMPDIR}/nonexistent_ca.crt" \
    -verify_return_error \
    -brief -no_ign_eof < /dev/null > "${TMPDIR}/case2_bad_ca.txt" 2>&1; then
    echo CASE2_EXIT=0
  else
    echo CASE2_EXIT=$?
  fi
  echo CASE2_HEAD_BEGIN
  head -n 80 "${TMPDIR}/case2_bad_ca.txt"
  echo CASE2_HEAD_END
else
  echo NEGATIVE_CASES_SKIPPED=no_certs_or_no_openssl
fi
rm -rf "${TMPDIR}"
echo DONE
